title: Orchestration features: ops rows, goal clause map, rescope, query log apply
goal: backlog.py ops SP prints a sprint's own operational rows; kb-sprint review and close show that output; precheck maps each goal clause to the check that reads it and warns of an unread clause; an operator rescopes a sprint goal and close --summary maps clauses to the sprint's own items; apply refuses a lead-passage row whose lead does not answer; pair_word's docstring and querylog.md give an example the one-candidate rule pairs

gates.question: Approve this sprint's goal and committed items?
